evidence: Using the plasma time of 3 s, the ABC process resulted in films with a higher refractive index (1.92) and density (2.84 g/cm3) than the corresponding 3 s AB process (1.84 and 2.72 g/cm3). The AlN films were crystalline according to the h-2h XRD scans (Fig. 4). Both thermal and PEALD films (AB 6 s and ABC 3 s) show a single distinct peak corresponding to the hexagonal (002) plane. The films are not ideal bulk AlN because of impurities coming from the deposition process.
